acceptanceConfig.JWT_SECRET: e2e-test-secret (test-only value, not a production secret)
acceptanceConfig.backend: node apps/backend/dist/index.js (Fastify + better-sqlite3 + embedded aedes MQTT + ws realtime)

acceptanceSteps.evidence: http=127.0.0.1:4100 mqtt=127.0.0.1:11883 ws=127.0.0.1:4101; health returned ok:true within ~3s of spawn
acceptanceSteps.title: Start backend on fresh ports; GET /api/health -> {ok:true}

acceptanceSteps.evidence: POST /api/auth/register -> 201 with {token, user, org}; org created for the user (credentials never logged)
acceptanceSteps.title: Register user e2e@test.local -> token + orgId

acceptanceSteps.evidence: POST /api/orgs/:orgId/projects -> 201; project id issued
acceptanceSteps.title: Create project 'Golden Room'

acceptanceSteps.evidence: POST /api/projects/:projectId/devices -> 201; deviceId matches DEV-XXXXX (e.g. DEV-M0ATTKY); pairing username device_<deviceId>; 24-char one-time pairing password returned (kept in memory only)
acceptanceSteps.title: Create device -> DEV-XXXXX + one-time pairing credentials

acceptanceSteps.evidence: virtual device process connected to mqtt://127.0.0.1:11883 and published telemetry; waited 5s
acceptanceSteps.title: Start virtual device (golden-room preset, tick 500ms)

acceptanceSteps.evidence: GET /api/devices/:deviceId -> device.status=ONLINE; capabilities=[fan, humidity, temperature] ingested from MQTT manifest
acceptanceSteps.title: Device ONLINE; capabilities include temperature/humidity/fan

acceptanceSteps.evidence: POST /api/pair -> 200 {ok:true, rotated:true, deviceToken present}; pairing row marked used, prior device credentials revoked
acceptanceSteps.title: Pair via API -> deviceToken; pairing credentials rotated

acceptanceSteps.evidence: re-pair with OLD password -> HTTP 404 (by design: unknown/used/expired pairings return not_found to avoid credential enumeration); virtual device restarted with the new deviceToken (same username) -> status ONLINE
acceptanceSteps.note: Task expected 401/400; actual 404 is the backend's deliberate anti-enumeration behavior. The essential property — old credential no longer works — held.
acceptanceSteps.title: Rotation: old pairing password rejected; device reconnects with new token

acceptanceSteps.evidence: second user registered (own org) -> GET /api/devices/:deviceId -> 404; POST /api/devices/:deviceId/commands -> 404 (device invisible cross-org)
acceptanceSteps.title: Authz isolation: second user cannot see or command the device

acceptanceSteps.evidence: GET /api/devices/:deviceId/telemetry?limit=5 -> rows returned; latest temperature=25.7 (in 22-28), humidity=62.3 (in 47-63); messageId present and contains deviceId
acceptanceSteps.title: Telemetry rows with in-range values and valid messageIds

acceptanceSteps.evidence: WS ws://127.0.0.1:4101: sent {type:auth, token} + {type:subscribe, projectId}; received {type:event, event:{kind:device.telemetry, deviceId}}
acceptanceSteps.title: Realtime WS: device.telemetry event received within 15s

acceptanceSteps.evidence: POST /api/devices/:deviceId/commands {capabilityId:fan, action:set, params:{value:true}, ttlMs:30000} -> 201; polled GET commands until status=SUCCEEDED; result.reportedState.fan===true; WS received command.acknowledged for the commandId
acceptanceSteps.title: Command fan=set(true) -> SUCCEEDED; WS command.acknowledged

acceptanceSteps.evidence: POST command params {value:'banana'} -> 400 {error:invalid_parameter}. Published raw MQTT command with expiresAt in the past (issuedAt now-60s) to aiot/v1/.../command as cmd_exp1 -> virtual device published result {status:EXPIRED} on the command topic (observed over MQTT); backend recorded no phantom EXPIRED row for the unknown commandId (results are only accepted for known commands); fan reported state still true (no actuation)
acceptanceSteps.note: The EXPIRED result is asserted on the MQTT command topic, not via GET commands, because the backend deliberately ignores results for commandIds it never issued.
acceptanceSteps.title: Safety: 400 invalid_parameter; expired raw MQTT command rejected by device with EXPIRED result

acceptanceSteps.evidence: killed virtual device process (SIGKILL); polled GET /api/devices/:deviceId -> status=OFFLINE (broker LWT presence); WS received device.offline event
acceptanceSteps.title: SIGKILL virtual device -> LWT -> OFFLINE + WS device.offline

acceptanceSteps.evidence: restarted virtual device with the rotated deviceToken -> status=ONLINE; WS received device.online event
acceptanceSteps.title: Reconnect with current token -> ONLINE + WS device.online

acceptanceSteps.evidence: POST /api/projects/:projectId/automations {name:heat-fan, deviceId, enabled:true, condition:{temperature,>,10}, action:{fan,set,{value:true}}} -> 201; automation-triggered command with createdBy=automation:<id> appeared in GET commands within ~5s and executed on the virtual device (fan=set SUCCEEDED); automation deleted via DELETE -> 200
acceptanceSteps.title: Automation (temperature > 10 -> fan on) fires on telemetry ingest; rule deleted

acceptanceSteps.evidence: registered e2e-viewer@test.local, added as VIEWER to the org -> POST /api/devices/:deviceId/commands -> 403 (commands require ADMIN)
acceptanceSteps.title: Security: VIEWER member gets 403 on command POST

acceptanceSteps.evidence: 40 POST /api/auth/login with wrong password -> 10/40 returned HTTP 429 (auth limiter is 30 req/min/IP; 8 prior auth requests were inside the same window, so the tail of the burst tripped the limiter)
acceptanceSteps.title: Security: 40x wrong-password login burst -> rate limited (429)

acceptanceSteps.evidence: npm run build --workspace=@aiot/dashboard (tsc + vite) -> apps/dashboard/dist/index.html exists (0.82 kB), 58 modules transformed
acceptanceSteps.title: Dashboard production build

acceptanceSteps.evidence: aiot-sdk create --board esp32 --device-id DEV-E2EFW1 --device-name golden-e2e --sensor dht22 --sensor-pin 4 --actuator led --actuator-pin 2 --mqtt-host localhost --mqtt-port 11883 -> 18 files scaffolded. aiot-sdk test -> verdict PUBLISHABLE (static: manifest schema 3 capabilities, config, secret scan clean; compile: arduino-cli build passed; protocol topics; simulator round-trip 9/9 checks). Firmware binary /tmp/golden-e2e/build/esp32.esp32.esp32/golden-e2e.ino.bin exists (1048432 bytes)
acceptanceSteps.note: Output dir renamed from /tmp/aiot-e2e-firmware to /tmp/golden-e2e because arduino-cli requires the directory name to match the sketch name (golden-e2e.ino) — the CLI itself flags this. HARDWARE_SMOKE_TEST: not_run (no physical hardware), as documented in the SDK's TESTING.md gate.
acceptanceSteps.title: SDK firmware: aiot-sdk create + test -> PUBLISHABLE, real arduino-cli compile

cleanup: backend and virtual-device processes terminated after the run; /tmp/aiot-e2e.db was a scratch database
